These small fixtures retain the selectors and nesting contracts observed on public ATS pages on 2026-10-14. Employer/job content and all candidate values are fictional. No real application was filled or submitted. Scripts in the end-to-end spec are local stand-ins for page event handling, not the vendors' complete applications.

- **Workable:** rendered application at `https://apply.workable.com/credence/j/9AE63CB881/apply/`. First/last/email names, generated file inputs labelled Photo/Resume, screening controls and final native submit.
- **Jobvite:** rendered application at `https://jobs.jobvite.com/reveal/job/ocz0zfw4/apply`. Angular form name and submit expression, autocomplete fields, checkbox groups, and two attachment dialogs appended outside the form. The resume dialog is identified by its own paste label, not numeric position.
- **SmartRecruiters:** OneClick reached from `https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/ServiceNow/744000149338366-software-engineer`. `oc-oneclick-form`, nested open Lit roots, SPL inputs/phone/select/autocomplete, two resume dropzones and Next. Blank experience and education editors were opened and their rendered structure inspected without entering candidate data. `smartrecruiters-entries.html` covers repeatable entry boundaries, role/degree fields, current employment and month-year controls. The adapter opens the first empty editor only; the owner reviews and saves each entry. It does not automate a sequence of saves. `smartrecruiters-screening.html` reconstructs the platform's published text, textarea, radio, checkbox and single/multi autocomplete templates; **a real candidate was not advanced to that step**. `smartrecruiters-sources.json` records the observed/source-only distinction and asset hashes. `template[data-shadow]` is a local fixture encoding hydrated by tests; it is not vendor markup. Job context is read as inert JSON. Employer-specific conditional logic and advanced currency/shift/language/file widgets remain unverified.
- **iCIMS:** public job and email login gate at `https://careers-appliedsystems.icims.com/jobs/6419/sales-consultant/job`. Login requires a candidate account and was not passed. The profile fixture is a **contract reconstruction**, not a captured authenticated profile. Dropdown IDs, native select, visible anchor and listbox naming are confirmed by the platform's public `script/common/icimsDropdown.js` asset, release `platform_188.2.1.261007-495c1342264-11-pg-0`. First/last profile field IDs also appear in a first-hand [SeleniumBase report](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/78425764/seleniumbase-unable-to-select-a-value-from-a-dropdown-using-value-text-index); do not reuse the report's token-bearing candidate URL. [iCIMS candidate guide](https://community.icims.com/articles/Knowledge/Candidate-Guide-to-the-iCIMS-Talent-Platform). Authenticated flows and employer customizations remain unverified.

The four adapters cover these specific form contracts, not every tenant or stage. Screening questions use the existing rule/AI planning flow. The extension does not press Next, save entries, create accounts or submit applications. Existing acknowledgement rules may tick a checkbox and mark it for owner review; that behavior was not changed here. No consent was accepted on a real site during this verification. Confirmation detection is conservative and only recognizes explicit success; localized or changed confirmation pages can require a follow-up fixture.

Tests cover host boundaries, login exclusion, upload scoping, custom dropdowns, nested roots, opaque radio values, exact multi-selection and clearing, entry boundaries, month-year input, preserved manual values and no automatic submission. Existing adapter paths and UI styles are retained.
